description: Returns a recommended retail price reference in USD for a natural diamond. In Russian, present it as «Рекомендованная цена в ритейле», calculated «по стандартам отрасли». Round uses the existing Round data; other supported shapes use the Pear data as instructed by the expert. Preserve table_shape, table_basis, shape_proxy, weight approximation notes and the data date. No shape-specific discount is invented. This is not an offer, inventory, transaction price or guaranteed discount. Market discounts depend on market conditions; Maxim sources the best proposal, checks the stone against its certificate and arranges destination delivery. Do not infer affordability in a different currency.
name: estimate_retail_price
title: Рассчитать рекомендованную цену в ритейле
